issue_context.title: macos_userdefaults shell_out syntax deprecation warning
issue_context.body:
## Description
The macos_userdefaults produces a deprecation warning on its invocation of `shell_out`

## Chef Version
Reported from 16.1.x

## Client Output
```
* macos_userdefaults[...] action write
/opt/chef/embedded/lib/ruby/gems/2.7.0/gems/chef-16.1.0/lib/chef/resource/macos_userdefaults.rb:81:
warning: Using the last argument as keyword parameters is deprecated; maybe ** should be added to the call
```
